objective: External occupancy state at t from UTC sensor light at t and t-1
A1b_programs: V5-T3e frozen A1b truth table, no new candidate fitted
primary: Unweighted mean by occupied UTC day of (current_errors-persist_errors)/daily_pairs
conditional_day_stratification: day type determined using external labels only after source commitment; not input to A1b
statistics_boundary: correlated days and site confounding not eliminated; sign-test p is descriptive, not formal proof
source_independence_boundary: operator supplies source-id and makes independence claim; no third-party escrow, no blinded assurance
not_eligible_sources: all three previously inspected UCI files, even under a new basename
failure_policy: ineligible days -> INSUFFICIENT, failed screen -> NO_SUPPORT; never convert unavailable reward to negative
